boundaries.chunk: npz then atomic JSON with sha256; orphan npz possible on interruption
boundaries.game: _store returns after players/points/game/provenance, no aggregate completion hash
boundaries.queue: bounded to workers submitted; pending jobs in memory
boundaries.failure: future.result propagates but ProcessPoolExecutor context waits for running jobs
boundaries.publication: parent loads after pool shutdown; season then snapshot then views then wrapper exports
boundaries.activation: snapshot rename rollback plus .previous detection; export files individually atomic, pair may differ

decision: Preserve canonical chunk RNG; add hash-verified resume and complete-game receipts before early publication; reserve a parent compute slot while publishing. Season freshness must be explicit; early publication must preserve existing forecasts.
